original_description: Edits, audits, and drafts prose using a concrete anti-slop workflow. It composes narrative in coherent units of thought and movement, prefers meaningful syntactic hierarchy, and runs structural and cadence gates before returning fiction. It also repairs authorial-management leakage, redundant demonstrations, procedural bookkeeping, semantic beat stacking, staccato cadence, unearned micro-interpretation, mechanical dialogue, canned significance, generic abstraction, templated rhetoric, and promotional puffery while preserving the writer's facts, voice, pacing, and genre.
summary_ja: 書き手の文体や意味を保ちながら、文章の構造や表現を見直す。
limitations: 公式説明上、文体や意味の維持を目指す。実際の編集品質は未検証。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
